name: Hoshino Ichika
source:
Though she looks cool and stoic on the outside, Ichika is a kind girl who is always thinking about her friends. She is childhood friends with [url=/c123760]Saki[/url], [url=/c128182]Honami[/url], and [url=/c128183]Shiho[/url], but her relationships with Honami and Shiho have become strained due to a certain incident.

She is the guitarist and vocalist of Leo/Need.

[From in-game profile]
